 Justice S.K. Sahoo
 Order

This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
This is an application for bail.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The appellant-petitioner has been convicted under section 376(1) of the I.P.C. and sentenced to undergo R.I. for a period of ten years and to pay a fine of Rs.10,000/- (rupees ten thousand), in default, to undergo R.I. for a further period of one year by the learned Sessions Judge, Cuttack in S.T. Case No.324 of 2016.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that // 2 // twice the petitioner has been granted interim bail and after availing the said interim bail periods, he surrendered before the learned trial Court at right time.
He further submitted that since paper book has not been prepared and there is no chance of early of the appeal in the near future, the petitioner may be granted interim bail for some period.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has no serious objection to such prayer.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties, period of detention of the petitioner in judicial custody, sentence imposed and the conduct of the petitioner in complying with the earlier interim bail orders, I am inclined to release him on interim bail for a period of three months from the date of release.
The petitioner shall immediately surrender before the learned Court below on expiry of the said three months period.

For the above period, let the petitioner be released on interim bail to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court in connection with the aforesaid case on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/-(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter including the conditions that the petitioner shall not indulge in any criminal activities.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
// 3 // The I.A. is disposed of accordingly.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge 08.
List this matter in the week commencing from 29th January 2024.
Learned counsel for the appellant shall file the surrender certificate of the appellant in the meantime.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge amit
